# migration/ (Onboarding data migration)

Multi-step wizard for importing from Sage / QuickBooks / CSV. Flow: create session → CoA → customers/suppliers/invoices → opening balances → validate → complete. Sage browser-pull moved to admin side in 4c03a7b.

## Endpoints
- `GET /api/accounting/migration/session` — active in-progress session (`{ session: null }` if none)
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/session` — create `{ sourceSystem }` (201) or complete `{ sessionId, action: 'complete' }`
- `GET /api/accounting/migration/validate` — run checks (`?sessionId=`); `{ checks, allPassed, summary }`
- `GET /api/accounting/migration/templates` — stream CSV (`?sourceSystem=&step=`); `Content-Disposition: attachment`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/chart-of-accounts` — `{ sessionId, accounts[], systemAccountMap }`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/customers` — `{ sessionId, customers[], duplicateStrategy }`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/suppliers` — `{ sessionId, suppliers[], duplicateStrategy }`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/ar-invoices` — `{ sessionId, invoices[] }`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/ap-invoices` — `{ sessionId, invoices[] }`
- `POST /api/accounting/migration/opening-balances` — `{ sessionId, effectiveDate, balances[] }`

## Auth
All routes: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` — `owner|admin|manager` only.

`templates.ts` streams raw CSV — do NOT unwrap `json.data`. All other JSON routes use `apiResponse.success|.created|.badRequest|.notFound|.validationError`.

Note: Sage browser-pull tool (`sage-pull`) moved admin-side (not under this path) in commit 1ec39129 — tenants no longer have that endpoint.

## Business rules
- `sessionId` is required on every import POST — first validation before dispatch
- `session` POST handles both `create` (no `action`) and `complete` (`action: 'complete'`)
- `validate` is read-only — `allPassed=false` should block the wizard from advancing to complete
- `chart-of-accounts` requires `systemAccountMap` alongside accounts array
- `customers`/`suppliers` use `duplicateStrategy` (`skip|update|create_new`) to disambiguate

## Related files
- `src/modules/accounting/services/core/migration*.ts` — session, imports, validation
- `pages/accounting/migration/*.tsx` — wizard UI
- Admin-side Sage pull: `pages/api/admin/migration/sage-pull.ts`
